QuestInfo.name: Commander of the Past
QuestInfo.0: Maha says my #bfriend#k came to Rien. What is he saying? Maybe Lilin will know.
QuestInfo.1: Maha says my friend came to Rien. What is he saying? Maybe Lilin will know.
QuestInfo.2: The person who came to help was one of the five heroes, #bPhantom#k. Even after all this time, he still checks in covertly. With Phantom's information, you now know the creator of the Black Wings is one of the Commanders, #rOrchid#k. Facing her will be inevitable in the fight against the Black Mage.
